meta.name: multi-cloud-architecture
meta.description: Design multi-cloud architectures using a decision framework to select and integrate services across AWS, Azure, GCP, and OCI. Use when building multi-cloud systems, avoiding vendor lock-in, or leveraging best-of-breed services from multiple providers.

copy.tagline: 设计多云架构,规避厂商锁定
copy.fit_line: 适合你,如果需要同时在多家云上搭建系统
copy.tagline_en: Design multi-cloud systems and avoid vendor lock-in
copy.fit_line_en: For you if you're building across multiple cloud providers

howto.what: Claude 会基于决策框架,对比 AWS、Azure、GCP、OCI 四家云的计算、存储、数据库等服务,按多云模式设计架构,并给出成本优化与分阶段迁移步骤。
howto.when: 当你提出要构建多云系统、避免供应商锁定,或要求跨云服务选型、迁移、成本优化时触发。

say.text: 我想做云无关架构,用 Kubernetes 和 PostgreSQL,给个方案
say.note: Claude 会给出抽象层和部署架构建议。

say.text: 评估我从单云迁到多云的成本和迁移步骤
say.note: 会产出分阶段迁移计划与成本优化点。

howto.what_en: Claude will compare compute, storage, and database services across AWS, Azure, GCP, and OCI using decision tables, then design multi-cloud architectures with relevant patterns and provide cost optimization and phased migration steps.
howto.when_en: Triggered when you ask to build multi-cloud systems, avoid vendor lock-in, or request cross-cloud service selection, migration, or cost optimization.

say_en.text: Compare AWS Lambda and GCP Cloud Functions use cases.
say_en.note: Gives a table-style comparison and suggested scenarios.

say_en.text: I want a cloud-agnostic architecture with Kubernetes and PostgreSQL.
say_en.note: Provides abstraction layers and architecture suggestions.

say_en.text: Estimate the cost and migration steps from single-cloud to multi-cloud.
say_en.note: Produces a phased migration plan and cost levers.
